thread:
Marta: FYI — LumenWave reached out asking to onboard a custom summarizer for a medical triage product. They say it will process PHI, need private deployment (VPC + HSM/KMS), EU data residency, and a low-latency target (they requested p50 <200ms, L95 <2s). They also want a short pilot with an eval plan. Can eng/security weigh in? CC @Raj @Sofia @Samir :wave:

Raj: Quick read — for PHI + HSM we should push Private. For latency/cost tradeoff I'd recommend 7B with INT8 + adapter tuning rather than 13B to hit p50 targets. Need to confirm sample prompts and expected output schema. Also: adapter + fine-tune vs retrieval-augmented? Both change eval scope.

Elaine: Flagging renewal risk — customer said SLA is a deciding factor for the annual renewal. If we can't demonstrate latency and data controls in pilot they'll likely pause. Let's be conservative in commitments.

Sofia: Security checklist questions: do they have an existing KMS? Are there third-party PHI processors? Confirm EU region for all storage and audit logs retention. I'll start DPA and security questionnaire. Also planning a brief architecture review with infra. :lock:

Samir: Infra notes: 7B quantized on a single A100 can get ~120ms p50 for short sequences if we avoid aggressive batching; L95 depends on load (can be 700-900ms). 13B will need multi-GPU and higher cost; also happy-path cold-starts will spike. If they want <200ms L95 under load we need reserved capacity (Dedicated). I'll produce a capacity/cost sketch.

Marta: Eval asks from customer: safety checks (hallucination on triage prompts), PHI redaction/PII leakage tests, semantic similarity quality (ROUGE-like + human spot checks). They asked for a 300 prompt safety suite and a 1k sample effectiveness set. Can we own that delivery?

Raj: I can run the first quality sweep — need a 1k sample and 100 labeled golden summaries. Also need exact prompt templates and any rejection logic they'd like. I'll draft an eval harness that outputs accuracy, hallucination rate, and verbatim leakage incidents.

deploy-bot: New intake ticket created: REQ-2123 — LumenWave summarizer private onboarding. Assigned: Raj, Samir. Priority: P1. Attachments: none yet.

Sofia: I'll open the security intake ticket and assign legal/infosec reviewers. Also will confirm HSM vendor compatibility with their KMS.

Elaine: Timeline — customer asked for pilot in 4 weeks. Is that achievable? They want a short pilot to validate latency, PHI handling, and quality before commit.

Samir: 4 weeks is tight but doable for a 7B private pilot: week 1 security + infra provisioning, week 2 model adapter + baseline tests, week 3 eval + fixes, week 4 pilot run and handover. Need priority provisioning and customer's sample data ASAP. Marking as high priority.

Marta: Action items: (1) Raj - confirm adapter vs RAG approach and send initial eval plan by EOD; (2) Samir - capacity & cost estimate by tomorrow; (3) Sofia - start DPA/security thread + region/HSM checks; (4) Elaine - schedule kickoff call with customer for Monday. I'll capture everything in the CS playbook and track renewal risk.

Raj: On it — will post eval plan and a minimal CLI to run local tests. Expect a short RFC with scoring thresholds.

Elaine: Adding note to account — high-touch for next 6 weeks, possible renewal conversion if pilot goes well. Will prepare a flexible contract addendum.

Sofia: :thumbsup:

Samir: I'll drop the capacity sketch in REQ-2123 later today and ping infra ops for warm nodes.

Marta: Thanks team — I'll follow up after kickoff. Please add any blockers to the intake ticket.
